initiatives.name: Spark AI
initiatives.strategicValue: Helps creators draft captions and replies with transparent, trustworthy AI assistance
initiatives.uxContribution: Interaction design for caption suggestions, prompt guidance, transparency patterns, and error states across Feed and Reels.

initiatives.name: Reels Remix
initiatives.strategicValue: Expands creator reach through remix attribution while protecting original content rights
initiatives.uxContribution: Interaction design for remix flows, attribution labels, and consent patterns across Feed and Reels surfaces.

initiatives.name: Collab Posts
initiatives.strategicValue: Enables co-authored content and shared credit on Feed without fragmenting the posting experience
initiatives.uxContribution: Designing invite flows, co-author attribution, and publish states for multi-creator posts.

initiatives.name: Creator Insights
initiatives.strategicValue: Gives creators actionable reach and engagement data in a format they can act on
initiatives.uxContribution: Dashboard and visualization design for creator analytics, benchmarks, and trend summaries.

aiClientFacing.contribution: Designed confidence labels, edit previews, and fallback states for AI-generated captions.
Defined error state UX, suggestion prompt patterns, and zero-state design.
Designed plain-language purchase status patterns to reduce checkout anxiety.

opportunities.description: Identified opportunity to consolidate 3 separate creator workflows into a single Creator Studio hub. Proactively proposed to product — now scoped for Q3.
Reframed a "notification redesign" brief into a broader communication strategy encompassing in-app, email, and SMS. Stakeholders adopted the wider scope.
Proposed a "human-in-the-loop" pattern library for AI features — reusable across AI projects. Approved as a design system initiative.
Discovered that 3 separate teams were designing their own empty state patterns. Flagged duplication — now standardized in Prism.

valueAddCards.note: Creator Studio layout changed before dev handoff — no rework required.
Spark AI caption UI approved by creator council after prototype review.
Creators completing clip trimming 40% faster in UAT vs. previous flow.
Complex filter system abandoned after usability testing — 3 sprint equivalent saved.
Checkout confirmation redesign received unsolicited positive feedback in user interviews.
